slug: # Every URL this pass newly LINKS is probed here. 0 new rows were published, so this is the link set of the prose, not of a shelf table.
# CHANNEL FINDING, worth more than the five rows: `curl -sI` against github.com HTML returned 403 for ALL FIVE, INCLUDING `microsoft/autogen`.
#   A uniform 403 across a set that contains a certainly-existing repository is a PROXY REFUSAL, not an existence answer -- the channel
#   cannot discriminate, so it must not be read as a 404 would be. This is `ACTION UK` applied to the verification channel itself, and
#   `ACTION TC` already named the oracle that does work: one `git ls-remote --symref` per slug, which also pins the HEAD.
# The mandate says to verify every URL before writing it. It is verified -- just not by the tool the mandate names, because that tool is
#   blind from here. The substitution is recorded rather than left for a later pass to rediscover (`p798-proxy-refusal-ledger`).
